notes: This file records competitor gaps that were observed or reported in the original project.
It is not used to generate answers. Competitive claims must be re-checked against a dated source before publication.
The previous version paired every gap with a 'Sahaaya AI solution' that the code did not implement, including counterfeit detection and real-time street navigation. Those claims were removed.

existing_technologies_and_gaps.intended_purpose: Offline identification of Indian banknote denominations for visually impaired users.
existing_technologies_and_gaps.documented_scope: RBI states that MANI does not authenticate banknotes and that user discretion is advised.
observed_gaps: Not an authentication or counterfeit-detection tool.
Performance varies with lighting, crumpling and older series notes.

existing_technologies_and_gaps.intended_purpose: Scan and read printed documents, including Indian languages.
observed_gaps: Institutional or hardware-assisted workflow rather than a phone-only offline reader.
Pricing and setup can limit personal ownership.

existing_technologies_and_gaps.intended_purpose: Ultrasonic obstacle detection attached to a white cane.
observed_gaps: Detects above-ground obstacles; it is not a drop-off or pothole detector.
It is a hardware device, not a phone app.

existing_technologies_and_gaps.technology: General-purpose scene assistants (for example Seeing AI, Lookout, Envision)
existing_technologies_and_gaps.intended_purpose: Scene description, OCR and object recognition.
observed_gaps: Not designed around Indian currency, coins and scheme paperwork.
